The broader claim that both sub-cases exist in the packet is still true (e.g. seed 43's 42-1, seed 46's 55-30, seed 55's 25-15 are genuine non-regrouping examples), just not via the cited example. scale_appropriateness's '100' count (seeds 42, 501, 502) was independently verified correct (exactly 3 items). summary: 9 of 25 filed reviews (36%) contain at least one verifiably false numeric or coverage claim inside their rationale, which is a check-1 failure regardless of whether the node's overall PASS/CONCERN/FAIL verdict happens to be right: q2_1 and q2_3 each mischaracterize one cited sample's digit-count/frame; q2_5 misclassifies a subtraction pair as 'non-regrouping' when it mathematically requires borrowing; q2_8 invents a '0-91' numeric span where the true span is 0-88 (the 91 figure belongs to sibling node q2_9); q3_0 and q3_1 (which share an identical sample set) both claim 'every/all' samples follow a repeated-addition pattern when 3-4 of 11 samples plainly do not; q3_3 understates the true maximum product by more than half (36 vs. the actual 80); and q4_2 and q4_5 (siblings sharing a near-identical but not identical sample set) both carry a word-for-word template rationale in their variant_comprehensiveness finding, listing the identical five seed numbers as 'the only' fraction items in both nodes despite each packet actually containing 2-3 additional fraction-identification items the template omits. Encouragingly, none of these errors flip the underlying verdict direction: in every voided node, the other 4-5 sub-findings independently and correctly justify the overall PASS/CONCERN/FAIL called, and my blind independent re-judgment of 5 pseudo-random nodes (q2_1, q2_6, q3_0, q3_5, q4_2 -- spanning both voided and clean nodes) agreed with the filed overall verdict in all 5 cases (0% disagreement). So the reviewer's judgment about which nodes are broken is trustworthy, but its specific evidentiary claims (counts, spans, 'all/every' assertions) cannot be cited or trusted at face value without independent recount -- exactly the miscounting failure mode flagged going in. Given the void rate clears the 'more than a couple' threshold by a wide margin, the batch is marked unreliable as filed and would need its false sub-claims corrected (not its verdicts reversed) before the evidence trail can be trusted.
